# Article Templates

Copy a template before writing a new article. Do not edit the master template unless you intend to change the structure for all future articles.

- [Polity template](polity-template.md)
- [City template](city-template.md)
- [Person template](person-template.md)
- [Event template](event-template.md)
- [Language template](language-template.md)

## Visual planning

Every new substantive article automatically receives category-specific image placeholders in the live site. Use the [Image & Visual Guide](../reference/image-guide.md) when replacing them with maps, flags, portraits, diagrams, or artwork.
